method: Read top-level dash items outside fenced blocks under the selected version headers in the six fixed changelogs. Ordinal IDs are stable within this immutable sourceRef. classificationPolicy: Assessments are normalized and referenced by source entries. E requires concrete local evidence; F requires an explicit scope reason; unverified entries stay V and are not closed. A shared upstream issue number is not a deduplication key (notably #9265 and #11599). Multiple assessment IDs preserve independent concerns within one source entry. Source entries are never summed as defects.
